svg.title: Renan Augusto - light technical profile
svg.desc: Static accessible terminal profile. The Visual Map contains only an identity-preserving portrait traced as one-bit particle paths; the animated version morphs it into C#, Flutter and C++ particle glyphs. Only verified public profile facts are included.
